title: Apply 10x Faster
shortDescription: AI-powered resume and cover letter optimization for job applications

content.overview: The 'Apply 10x Faster' feature uses AI to automatically analyze your resume against job descriptions and generate an optimized resume and cover letter tailored to each job posting.

steps.title: Analyze Your Resume
steps.description: Upload your resume (PDF or document format). The AI scans your resume and extracts key skills, experience, and qualifications, then analyzes how well your background matches the job description.
details: Resume Match Score: A percentage showing how much your resume aligns with the job keywords
- ✅ Full Matches: Skills that directly match the job posting
- ✅ Partial Matches: Related skills that partially align
- ❌ Missing: Important keywords/skills not in your resume
steps.example:
Your resume matches 38% of job keywords
✓ 3 Full Matches
✓ 3 Partial Matches
✗ 6 Missing

steps.title: Optimize Resume & Cover Letter
steps.description: The AI generates an improved resume tailored to the specific job and creates a customized cover letter that highlights your strongest fit for the role.
details: Optimized resume that better targets the job posting
Compelling cover letter that addresses the job requirements directly
Both documents ready to submit instantly

resumeOptimization.title: Resume Optimization
items: Keyword Enhancement: Incorporates relevant job posting keywords naturally
Experience Reordering: Prioritizes experience most relevant to the job
Achievement Highlighting: Emphasizes accomplishments that match job requirements
Format Preservation: Maintains professional structure and readability

coverLetterGeneration.title: Cover Letter Generation
items: Job-Specific Content: Written specifically for this role and company
Skill Alignment: Highlights how your skills match job requirements
Professional Tone: Maintains industry-standard formatting and language
Ready to Submit: Instantly generated and ready to use

instructions.action: Navigate to the Apply 10x Faster page
instructions.detail: Select your job posting from RemoteHunter
Click 'Add Resume' or drag/drop your file. Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, DOC
Check your resume match percentage and skills breakdown. Click 'See Skills Match Analysis' for details
Click 'Optimize Resume for Job'. Review the generated resume and cover letter
Copy or download the optimized documents for your job application

benefits: ✅ Save Time: Generate optimized resume and cover letter in seconds
✅ Better Results: Increase chances of passing resume screening
✅ Keyword Optimization: Ensure your resume contains job-relevant keywords
✅ Professional Quality: AI-generated documents maintain high quality
✅ Multiple Applications: Create tailored documents for each job you apply to

faq.q: Can I edit the generated resume and cover letter?
faq.a: Yes, all generated documents can be edited after generation.

faq.q: How accurate is the resume match percentage?
faq.a: The match is based on keywords and skills from both your resume and the job description. A higher percentage indicates better alignment with the role.

faq.q: What if I have multiple versions of my resume?
faq.a: You can add multiple resumes and the system will analyze each one separately.

faq.q: Can I use the generated cover letter without changes?
faq.a: Yes, the cover letter is ready to use immediately, but you can customize it if desired.
Resume analysis takes about 30-60 seconds. Cover letter generation is instant.

faq.q: Will this guarantee I get the job?
faq.a: Optimized documents increase your chances of passing initial resume screening, but hiring decisions depend on many factors beyond document optimization.

tips: Keep Your Resume Updated: Ensure your resume reflects your current skills and experience
Be Specific: Include concrete examples and metrics in your resume
Review Generated Content: Always review the generated resume and cover letter before submitting
Customize When Needed: Add personal touches to the cover letter to make it more authentic
Apply Promptly: Submit your application soon after generation for best results
